description.value: Miku Richmond is an upscale Japanese restaurant specializing in Aburi cuisine — traditional sushi elevated with contemporary sauces and live-flame searing — located on the third level of River Rock Casino Resort along the Fraser River waterfront. Part of the award-winning Miku group that has pioneered Aburi cuisine in North America since 2008, the Richmond location emphasizes locally sourced B.C. produce alongside fine Japanese ingredients and a private dining program. It opened in early 2026 as Miku's newest outpost.
